subject: Banking
title: Interchange Fees on Every Swipe
description: A micro-lesson that makes Interchange Fees on Every Swipe usable.

hook.text: Every time you swipe a card, the merchant pays 1.5-3% to the bank. US interchange fees exceeded $100 billion in 2022.

buildup.text: The fee is split between the card network, the issuing bank, and the payment processor. The bank gets the largest share.

discovery.text: Interchange fees fund credit card rewards. Banks earn 2% on your purchase and give you back 1% in points.

twist.text: Merchants raise prices to cover interchange fees. Cash customers subsidize card users' rewards without knowing it.

climax.text: Interchange fees are invisible to cardholders but visible in every price tag. You pay whether you use a card or not.

punchline.text: $100 billion in swipe fees. Hidden in every purchase you make.

quiz.question: Who ultimately pays interchange fees?
options: Merchants, who pass the cost to all customers through higher prices
